title: Original Medicare Part B and medical practice billing
buyer_vs_payee: The federal payer reimburses care; the patient is not the federal procurement buyer. Rendering and billing identities can differ.
join_plan: Retain NPI as a ten-character string and validate check digit. Keep Type 1 individual and Type 2 organization separate.
Join NPI to the same observation-period NPPES snapshot; retain taxonomy and professional practice state.
Compare by HCPCS, place of service, specialty, calendar year, regional payment conditions and available risk/case-mix proxies.
Resolve group ownership through explicit enrollment/registry evidence; never infer ownership from a shared practice address.

hypotheses.signal: Abrupt rise in units or paid amount for a narrow HCPCS family
hypotheses.needed: Prior-year records, dictionary comparability, paid-vs-submitted amount, enrollment history and a validated peer cohort.

hypotheses.signal: Provider appears on exclusion data and billing aggregates
hypotheses.needed: Exact identity, exclusion effective/reinstatement dates and actual dates of service; annual aggregates alone cannot prove prohibited billing.

blind_spots: No patient-level identity or clinical record in public aggregates.
Part B FFS is not the full US health market.
Annual aggregates cannot establish impossible daily workloads, forged signatures or deliberate misrepresentation.
agent: Claims-methodology auditor: reject invalid cohorts, enforce amount semantics and flag only reproducible aggregate anomalies.

title: DMEPOS, catheters, orthotics and medical supply distribution
funds_path: CMS FFS through MAC OR MA plan
buyer_vs_payee: A billed supplier is not necessarily the manufacturer or federal contract vendor. Reimbursement does not expose its wholesale purchase invoice.
join_plan: Use supplier NPI + HCPCS + rental indicator + service year as aggregate grain.
Create separate records for referring-provider and supplier datasets. They are marginal aggregates; shared HCPCS does not establish a direct referrer-to-supplier transaction.
Use NPI business identity and explicit corporate filings to trace registered entity/parents. Record each unsupported upstream manufacturer or beneficial-owner link as unknown.
Version enrollment, deactivation, revocation and exclusion as different statuses with effective dates. A billing transition to another payer requires payer-specific data.

hypotheses.signal: New or acquired supplier shows an extreme catheter billing increase relative to peers
hypotheses.needed: Longitudinal supplier rows, valid acquisition source, product mix, beneficiary-count denominator and payer-specific data.

hypotheses.signal: Several suppliers share an officer/address and similar billing shocks
hypotheses.needed: Explicit ownership/control records and distinct contemporaneous entities; cluster is a lead, not conspiracy proof.

blind_spots: Public aggregate data cannot establish delivery, beneficiary death, consent or medical necessity.
Commercial supplier-to-wholesaler/manufacturer sales are usually not public.
2026 suspected billing cannot be confirmed with a 2024 aggregate dataset.
agent: DME coding and network auditor: compare product-specific longitudinal cohorts and distinguish NPI/provider enrollment changes from legal-entity ownership changes.

title: Medicaid/CHIP, managed care, behavioural health and home/community services
funds_path: FFS provider OR capitated managed-care organization
buyer_vs_payee: State expenditure, MCO capitation, provider reimbursement and managed-care encounter value are different measures and must not be summed as independent spending.
join_plan: Retrieve HHS HCPCS, NDC and enrollment extracts, schema, suppression and revision documentation before querying.
Preserve billing NPI, servicing NPI and prescribing NPI as distinct roles. Add state, month and code-system version where fields support it.
Validate cross-state/method comparability and managed-care encounter amount definitions; do not assume an encounter paid amount equals a state payment.
Join provider enrollment segments temporally, keeping state-specific enrollment identifiers and spans.

hypotheses.signal: Rapid provider-month growth in behavioural health or personal-care units
hypotheses.needed: State benefit/rate chronology, claim revisions, enrollment spans, code dictionaries and comparable states/regions.

hypotheses.signal: Same provider has apparent high hours per month
hypotheses.needed: Provider role, unit semantics, staffing evidence and appropriately authorized service records; public aggregate totals cannot prove impossible individual hours.

blind_spots: T-MSIS is state-submitted and has completeness/comparability limitations.
Suppression prevents reconstructing small cells.
No patient identities; do not attempt reidentification or deceased-beneficiary joins.
Managed-care subcontract and staffing contracts may be unavailable.
agent: Medicaid state-policy auditor: condition every rule on state, year, programme and payment method; route missing definitions to blocked-data status.

title: Pharmaceutical supply, Part D prescribing, PBMs and rebates
funds_path: CMS Part D subsidies and other payer contributions
PBM and affiliated group purchasing organization
buyer_vs_payee: Drug acquisition, dispensing reimbursement, prescribing and rebate flows are distinct. Public Part D drug cost is not net federal spending, pharmacy revenue or manufacturer realized price.
join_plan: Use prescribing NPI + brand/generic drug + year for Part D; NDC-bearing Medicaid data has a different grain.
Preserve NDC format and package/product meaning; do not coerce away leading zeros or infer drug equality from string similarity.
Use explicit corporate evidence for PBM/plan/pharmacy/manufacturer ownership and effective dates.
Open Payments linking needs the current file layout and validated recipient crosswalk; do not assume every release exposes NPI. Keep payments, research and ownership as separate relations.

hypotheses.signal: Very high brand share or spend per standardized fill in matched peers
hypotheses.needed: Drug identity, days supply, specialty, formulary/year and rebate limitations.

hypotheses.signal: Payment relationship and unusual prescribing co-occur
hypotheses.needed: Actual agreement, timing, services and a legally supported inducement theory. Correlation is insufficient.

blind_spots: Manufacturer rebates, PBM spread contracts and net prices often confidential.
Part D prescriber tables do not identify every dispensing pharmacy transaction.
FTC competition proceedings are not automatically criminal or FCA findings.
agent: Drug-pricing and formulary auditor: normalize drug/packaging/payment measures and challenge gross-cost versus net-cost mistakes.

title: Clinical laboratories, urine drug tests and genetic testing
buyer_vs_payee: An ordering physician is not automatically an owner or procurement buyer; an advertised test brand does not uniquely identify the billing laboratory.
join_plan: Resolve NPI and CLIA certificate separately, using explicit crosswalk or corroborated location/legal name and certificate dates.
Compare CPT/HCPCS families with site-of-service and year-specific billing rules; preserve modifiers when available.
Record marketers/MSOs only if documented; never convert a co-located company into a financial intermediary.

hypotheses.signal: High same-family test intensity or spending concentration
hypotheses.needed: Coverage policy, ordering data, actual test panel, medical record and patient-specific indication under lawful access.
Contract/distribution/referral evidence and legal review; public association alone cannot establish a kickback.

blind_spots: Aggregate NPI/code totals cannot show same-patient same-day testing combinations.
CLIA certificate quality status is not Medicare billing approval or fraud determination.
Medical necessity and intent require additional records.
agent: Laboratory coding and CLIA auditor: require precise panel/code/date evidence and separate admitted facts from settlement allegations.

title: Telehealth, lead generation and remote prescribing
buyer_vs_payee: The platform can be a vendor, a clinical group or a billing entity; never assume these roles are interchangeable.
join_plan: Preserve practitioner NPI, platform legal entity, billed supplier and marketer as distinct nodes.
Use only explicit contracts/case records to connect lead seller and provider.
Version telehealth place-of-service/payment rules and distinguish authorized telehealth expansion from misconduct.

hypotheses.signal: DME/lab billing growth accompanies remote ordering concentration
hypotheses.needed: Validated ordering linkage, encounter evidence and consent documentation; marginal aggregates cannot prove a path.

hypotheses.signal: Unusual volume associated with a new telehealth group
hypotheses.needed: Role-correct numerator, denominator and clinician capacity evidence.

blind_spots: Call recordings, patient consent, identity theft and AI-generated consent records are not available in public spending tables.
No scraping patient/social accounts or trying to impersonate beneficiaries.
agent: Telehealth rule and consent-evidence auditor: distinguish legal remote care from source-supported conduct; block unsupported consent conclusions.

title: Hospice, home health and skilled nursing ownership networks
funds_path: CMS Part A / Medicaid / other programme
buyer_vs_payee: Patient referral, agency enrollment, facility operation and real-estate ownership are separate relations.
join_plan: Use ENROLLMENT ID and ASSOCIATE ID to join PECOS ownership rows to the matching enrollment dataset; obtain NPI/CCN from that supported crosswalk.
Keep owner ASSOCIATE ID distinct from provider ASSOCIATE ID and NPI.
Represent ownership percentage, role, association date and snapshot date; sum percentages only where ownership layer and definitions permit.
Recurse through evidenced organization owners; a self-reported intermediate owner is not proven ultimate beneficial ownership.

hypotheses.signal: Rapid facility enrollment or ownership turnover and unusual service patterns
hypotheses.needed: Snapshots/filings, provider operational dates, payment/quality denominators and explicit acquisition evidence.

hypotheses.signal: Hospice and separate provider payments may overlap
alternatives: unrelated condition or permitted separate benefit
hypotheses.needed: Patient/service-level records and hospice coverage rules; aggregate overlap alone is not duplicate billing.

blind_spots: Current ownership snapshot can misrepresent the historical owner.
Self-reported ownership may be incomplete or late.
Public service aggregates cannot establish terminal prognosis, homebound status, forged signatures or actual staff attendance.
Enhanced-oversight states are control jurisdictions, not a list of culpable providers.
agent: Post-acute ownership and eligibility auditor: version every ownership edge and require authorized clinical evidence before eligibility conclusions.

title: Medicare Advantage risk adjustment and delegated vendor networks
funds_path: delegated provider group / HRA or coding vendor
buyer_vs_payee: Capitation is an insurer payment, not reimbursement for one specific billed clinical service; chart review and care delivery can be performed by different entities.
join_plan: Keep contract/plan/year and parent organization effective dates; do not infer plan ownership from brand alone.
Preserve diagnosis submission/deletion, HRA and encounter origins if lawfully available.
Use public audits/settlements as typology evidence; do not pretend public NPI aggregates include underlying risk adjustment records.

hypotheses.signal: Risk-adjustment payment rises without corresponding service pattern in authorized data
hypotheses.needed: Validated diagnosis encounter histories, HCC model/year, deletion records and clinical documentation.

blind_spots: Public sources rarely expose complete enrollee diagnosis chains or HRA-vendor contracts.
OIG HRA-only payment estimates include alternative care-quality explanations and are not fraud loss estimates.
agent: Risk-adjustment evidence auditor: require correct model/version, supported diagnosis/deletion facts and legal-status precision.

title: VA community care, prosthetics and medical procurement
funds_path: third-party administrator OR direct procurement vendor
buyer_vs_payee: CCN claim reimbursement and a VA purchase order are different procurement/payment paths. Contract-compliant margins can be a policy weakness without being fraud.
join_plan: Identify CCN region, administrator contract, payment period and applicable rate hierarchy.
Trace actual award identifiers via the procurement system separately from NPI-based community-provider records.
Keep contract price, provider invoice and VA reimbursement measures separate; source the contract clause governing each.

hypotheses.needed: Executed contract and modifications, governing fee schedule, invoice and payment reconciliation.

hypotheses.signal: Medical procurement price above catalogue/reference price
hypotheses.needed: Item/NSN/UDI if available, comparable terms, quantities and period; no price-only fraud conclusion.

blind_spots: Patient-level VA claims and commercial upstream invoices usually restricted.
Questioned costs and recommendations for better use of funds are not recoveries.
2025 audit found most outpatient payments accurate; selecting only negative findings would distort evidence.
agent: VA contract-rate auditor: reconstruct the contract/rate hierarchy and challenge false fraud labels for permitted terms.
